description: Research queue of distinct attack checks. These entries are methods and required evidence, not positive weakness findings for any indexed curve.

items.name: Quadratic-twist subgroup confinement
items.requires: An accepted twist point and observable multiplication under a reused scalar
items.test: Count and factor the twist; test accepted inputs and output behavior; bound recoverable scalar residues.

items.name: Invalid-curve input
items.requires: Scalar multiplication accepts a point off the declared curve and reveals a secret-dependent result
items.test: Exercise the actual parser and multiplication path on constructed invalid points; verify resulting group orders.

items.name: Small-subgroup confinement
items.requires: Attacker-controlled low-order point, reused secret, and distinguishable output
items.test: Enumerate accepted low-order points and replay the protocol oracle for residue recovery.
items.source: Measuring small subgroup attacks against Diffie-Hellman

items.name: X25519 all-zero result
items.requires: Accepted low-order input and missing or ineffective all-zero shared-secret handling
items.test: Check the RFC 7748 input/output path and whether a zero result is rejected before key use.

items.name: G1 subgroup acceptance
items.requires: External G1 point with missing order-r check or cofactor clearing
items.test: Submit on-curve points outside G1[r] to the exact verifier and record acceptance and downstream use.

items.name: G2 twist subgroup acceptance
items.requires: External twist point with missing twist, subgroup, or infinity check
items.test: Verify twist equation, order-r membership, encoding, and accepted malformed points in the verifier.

items.name: GT subgroup acceptance
items.requires: Untrusted target-field element used as an order-r value without validation
items.test: Check nonzero field membership and r-th power/order conditions at the actual protocol boundary.

items.name: Hash-to-curve subgroup and domain separation
items.requires: Missing cofactor clearing, subgroup check, or domain separation for the intended group
items.test: Bind suite, DST, map, clear-cofactor step and output subgroup to the deployed call path.

items.name: Cheon r−1 auxiliary powers
items.scope: Selected prime-order group plus auxiliary input
items.requires: A supplied [x^d]G with d dividing r−1, in addition to G and [x]G
items.test: Factor r−1, inventory actual auxiliary points, then cost Cheon's algorithm for each supplied d.
items.source: Cheon, discrete logarithm with auxiliary input

items.name: Cheon r+1 auxiliary powers
items.scope: Selected prime-order group plus auxiliary input
items.requires: The paper's r+1 auxiliary-input pattern, including the required powers of one secret
items.test: Factor r+1 and verify the exact input sequence before estimating the applicable branch.
items.source: Cheon, discrete logarithm with auxiliary input

items.name: Structured-reference-string powers
items.requires: Public consecutive secret powers in a specified group and target secret relation
items.test: Inventory powers and exposure model; screen auxiliary-input algorithms against the real sequence.
items.source: Cheon, discrete logarithm with auxiliary input

items.name: Repeated ECDSA nonce
items.requires: Two distinct-message signatures under one key sharing a nonce
items.test: Compare signature r values, handle sign ambiguity, and replay the recovered signing key.

items.name: Biased ECDSA nonces
items.requires: A measurable nonce bias across enough signatures under one key
items.test: Characterize nonce distribution and test a lattice/hidden-number recovery with independent replay.

items.name: Partial nonce leakage
items.requires: Observed nonce bits or intervals tied to signatures under one key
items.test: Record leakage accuracy and samples, then validate key recovery against the public key.

items.name: Restricted scalar distribution
items.requires: Evidence that the secret lies in a constrained subset
items.test: Measure the actual key-generation law and compare interval or subset search with full-order search.
items.source: Computing discrete logarithms in an interval

items.name: Trace-zero subgroup index calculus
items.scope: Selected subgroup over an extension field
items.requires: Generator lies in the kernel of the extension trace map
items.test: Verify trace-zero membership; build natural relations, rank, final linear algebra and target descent.

items.name: Prime-field summation-polynomial index calculus
items.requires: An actual factor base and natural relation collection on E(F_p)
items.test: Measure decomposition success, independent rank, final solve and single-target recovery.

items.name: Cover search beyond the isogeny condition
items.requires: Constructed lower-field curve, cover map and injective selected-subgroup transfer
items.test: Search exact field towers and ramification conditions; verify smoothness, genus, map and kernel.
items.source: Covering classification without the isogeny condition

items.name: Same-field cover transfer
items.requires: A same-field covering plus a measured Jacobian route that improves the chosen task
items.test: Verify map, subgroup image and destination arithmetic; compare complete costs.

items.name: Joux–Vitse intermediate-field cover
items.scope: E/F_(p^(nd)) with composite degree nd and selected subgroup G
items.requires: An explicit H/F_(p^n), a cover H→E over F_(p^(nd)), and injective norm–pullback on G
items.test: Record exact tower, genus, model and map; check ker(N◦π*)∩G=0, factor base over F_p, natural relation rank, linear algebra and target descent. For F_(p^6), screen the p²/genus-three and p³/genus-two branches separately.

items.name: Joux–Vitse bihomogeneous quadratic sieve
items.scope: Odd-characteristic hyperelliptic H/F_(p²) reached from an elliptic subgroup
items.requires: A constructed lower-field cover, n=2, a factor base with x in F_p, and a saturated nontrivial relation ideal
items.test: Verify saturation removes μ=0 inverse-pair relations; replay the bihomogeneous system and quadratic root sieve, count full and partial relations of length 2g+2, then verify rank, linear algebra and target descent.

items.name: Genus-three hyperelliptic branch
items.requires: A genus-three destination and an explicit hyperelliptic model or a suitable nonhyperelliptic solver
items.test: Determine destination geometry before selecting a relation algorithm and costing transport.

items.name: Hyperelliptic divisor decomposition
items.scope: DLP in a specified hyperelliptic Jacobian
items.requires: A reduced divisor representation and a factor base of small-degree prime divisors
items.test: Decompose natural-query divisors over the exact factor base; verify each relation, rank growth, final linear algebra and target descent.

items.name: Hyperelliptic large-prime recombination
items.scope: DLP in a small-genus hyperelliptic Jacobian
items.requires: Verified partial divisor relations and a bounded large-prime policy
items.test: Record partial-relation yield, collision graph, recombined independent rows, matrix cost and target descent.

items.name: High-genus divisor smoothness
items.scope: DLP in a high-genus hyperelliptic Jacobian
items.requires: A finite field, genus, degree bound and explicit smoothness law for reduced divisors
items.test: Choose factor-base degree bound; compute or sample smoothness, relation rank, linear algebra and individual descent costs.

items.name: Jacobian isogeny decomposition
items.requires: A lower-dimensional factor over the declared field and a usable map from the selected subgroup
items.test: Factor the Weil polynomial, construct the isogeny and projections, certify kernels and generator images, then cost DLP in the reached factor.

items.name: Elliptic quotient and Prym complement
items.scope: Hyperelliptic cover of an elliptic curve
items.requires: An explicit cover H→E and maps between E, Jac(H), and the complementary factor
items.test: Check pullback/norm on the chosen subgroup; identify the complementary factor and measure whether it offers any useful projected route.

items.name: Binary Koblitz Frobenius orbit rho
items.scope: Selected subgroup of a binary Koblitz curve
items.requires: An efficiently computable Frobenius action with nontrivial orbit on that subgroup
items.test: Verify the endomorphism eigenvalue and orbit quotient; compare matched rho walks.

items.name: General automorphism quotient rho
items.requires: Efficient automorphism acting with nontrivial, usable orbits on the chosen subgroup
items.test: Construct the action, count exceptional orbits, and time a matched collision search.
items.source: Practical elliptic and hyperelliptic security analysis

items.name: Small-CM-discriminant structure
items.requires: Verified endomorphism order and an exploitable action on the selected subgroup
items.test: Compute discriminant and conductor separately; construct the action before estimating advantage.

items.name: Pairing-target tower NFS
items.requires: A verified pairing image and a field tower amenable to a finite-field DLP algorithm
items.test: Fix p, k, tower, polynomial selection and target; cost transfer, relation collection, linear algebra and descent.

items.name: Small-characteristic target-field DLP
items.requires: A pairing image in a field covered by a small-characteristic DLP algorithm
items.test: Verify image order and field representation; evaluate the relevant algorithm and transfer cost.

items.name: Scalar-ladder side-channel leakage
items.requires: Observable secret-dependent timing, power or memory behavior
items.test: Measure leakage on the actual binary and recover a held-out secret under the stated access model.

items.name: Exceptional-point formula behavior
items.requires: Special inputs trigger observably different formula behavior under a secret scalar
items.test: Identify exceptional points, exercise the real call path and verify a secret-dependent distinction.

items.name: Degenerate-curve arithmetic
items.requires: An invalid computation on a degenerate group with observable secret-dependent output
items.test: Reproduce the accepted input or fault, identify the resulting group and verify recovered-key replay.

items.name: Active SIDH malformed-key oracle
items.requires: Chosen public isogeny data, reused secret and a distinguishable shared-secret response
items.test: Match the active protocol inputs and oracle behavior in the published attack; verify a key-recovery transcript.

items.name: CSIDH short class-group relations
items.requires: A parameter set and secret distribution affected by short relations or collisions
items.test: Compute relation lattice and collision distribution for the exact action; compare key-search cost.

items.name: CSIDH quantum hidden-shift cost
items.requires: A specified group action, oracle model and quantum resource model
items.test: Derive the class-group size and action-evaluation cost; report quantum time, query and memory assumptions.
